item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find clear 2024 evidence that Sharif’s government systematically tied BISP, Ramazan aid, public jobs, permits, or food/housing benefits to political loyalty. The strongest negative evidence is instead about punitive treatment of vulnerable groups, refugees, and low-income residents. So the record supports “formal welfare delivery was mostly nonpartisan,” but it does not prove a fully clean state.","evidence":[{"title":"BENAZIR INCOME SUPPORT PROGRAMME HELPS ALL POOR AND DESERVING PEOPLE IRRESPECTIVE OF ANY POLITICAL AFFILIATION: CHAIRPERSON OF THE BENAZIR INCOME SUPPORT PROGRAMME RUBINA KHALID","publisher":"BISP","date":"2024-05-23","url":"https://www.bisp.gov.pk/NewsDetail/MjU0NDA1ZTItM2NiOC00NGE4LWJmNzctNGFiZTY4ZDFiZGFj","summary":"BISP said assistance goes to poor and deserving people regardless of political affiliation, with no registration fee and a transparent, dignified process. This is direct evidence against using welfare as a loyalty tool.","question_ids":["6B.7","6B.2","6B.3"]},{"title":"PM announces Rs 7.5 billion Ramazan relief package for poor people","publisher":"APP","date":"2024-03-07","url":"https://www.app.com.pk/national/pm-announces-rs-7-5-billion-ramazan-relief-package-for-poor-people/","summary":"Sharif announced a subsidy-based relief package for poor and middle-income households, paired with BISP disbursement, complaint handling, and anti-hoarding enforcement. The package was presented as a broad anti-inflation measure, not a loyalty screen.","question_ids":["6B.7","6B.2","6B.6"]},{"title":"PM enhances Ramazan package to Rs12.5 billion","publisher":"Dawn","date":"2024-03-11","url":"https://www.dawn.com/news/1820615","summary":"The government expanded the package, routed food relief through Utility Stores and BISP mobile units, and used mobile distribution and GPS-tracked trucks. That looks like mass welfare delivery rather than selective political favoritism.","question_ids":["6B.7","6B.2","6B.6"]},{"title":"PM Shehbaz directs full digitalization of social welfare payments under BISP","publisher":"APP","date":"2024-03-18","url":"https://www.app.com.pk/national/pm-shehbaz-directs-full-digitalization-of-social-welfare-payments-under-bisp/","summary":"Sharif ordered BISP disbursements onto digital wallets to curb leakages, improve transparency, and reduce queues and discretion. This is strong evidence for depoliticized, rule-based welfare delivery.","question_ids":["6B.7","6B.5","6B.2"]},{"title":"Pakistan must halt unlawful deportation of Afghan refugees","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-04-04","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/04/pakistan-government-must-halt-deportation-of-afghan-refugees/","summary":"Amnesty said Pakistan’s repatriation plan lacked transparency, due process, and accountability, and threatened arrests, harassment, and unlawful deportation of Afghan status-holders. This is negative evidence on permits, documentation, and access to employment/education for a vulnerable group.","question_ids":["6B.7","6B.2","6B.3"]},{"title":"Pakistan: Abusive Forced Evictions in Pakistan","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-05-28","url":"https://www.hrw.org/report/2024/05/28/i-escaped-only-my-life/abusive-forced-evictions-pakistan","summary":"HRW reported forcible evictions of low-income residents, shop owners, and street vendors without adequate notice, compensation, or resettlement, with loss of housing and livelihoods.
